context: Written on 2026-11-16 for the second rework batch. The skill was then revised against this task, so its with-skill score here is partly by construction. Measured without the skill on 2026-11-16 (Sonnet agent and Sonnet judge, 2 runs, pass/fail per criterion): predicted baseline failure is that the agent misses 'Shared modes file applied project-wide' (1 of 2 runs), 'Viewport names match' (1 of 2 runs). Converted from a four-criterion pass/fail screen; per EVALS.md, run a sham arm before quoting a lift from it.

checklist.name: Deliverables produced
checklist.description: ANSWER.md exists and holds the findings plus the final content of every file the agent created or changed. Scores zero if ANSWER.md is missing or no file the task needs was created or changed.

checklist.name: MUST NOT use the old chromatic.viewports parameter
checklist.description: From the skill's 'Themes and viewports: modes' section, which says modes replace it. Any story or preview that still sets `chromatic.viewports` scores zero. Full points when the work avoids it.

checklist.name: Modes, not the viewports parameter
checklist.description: The setup uses Chromatic modes (`parameters.chromatic.modes`) instead of the legacy `chromatic.viewports` parameter. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Shared modes file applied project-wide
checklist.description: Modes are defined once in `.storybook/modes.(js|ts)`, each setting the `viewport` and `theme` globals, and applied in `.storybook/preview` so every story gets them. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Viewport names match
checklist.description: The `viewport` values used in the modes are option keys defined in the preview's viewport options (`small`, `large`). Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Snapshot cost and baselines
checklist.description: The answer notes that Chromatic takes a separate snapshot per mode, with its own baseline and approval, so four modes multiply snapshots per story. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.
